original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚东北部武装分子袭击村庄，至少10名村民死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据警方称，不明身份枪手袭击了尼日利亚塔拉巴州卡里姆拉米多地区偏远的宾纳里村，至少10人死亡，商店遭洗劫，房屋被纵火。目击者称死亡人数达20人，一家人道组织称可能多达50人，实际死亡人数尚未确认。警方表示仍在丛林中搜寻其他伤亡人员，并警告死亡人数可能进一步上升。

location.site: 卡里姆拉米多地区宾纳里村
location.raw_text: Binnari village in the Karim Lamido area, Taraba state, north-east Nigeria

key_facts.fact: 警方称不明身份枪手袭击尼日利亚塔拉巴州宾纳里村，至少10人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Unknown gunmen have raided a remote village in the north-eastern Nigerian state of Taraba, killing at least 10 people, looting shops and setting houses ablaze, police say.

key_facts.fact: 目击者称死亡人数达20人，一家人道组织称可能多达50人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: There are fears the actual death toll is much higher, with eyewitnesses speaking of 20 lives lost and a non-governmental organisation suggesting a toll of as many as 50.

key_facts.fact: 警方称在接到求救后找到10具枪伤尸体，并警告死亡人数可能上升
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: police said they recovered 10 bodies with gunshot wounds after officers responded to a distress call... warned the death toll could still rise.

key_facts.fact: 社区领袖称袭击者乘坐约50辆摩托车抵达，洗劫商店并抢走现金、食品等物资
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Community leader Malam Abubakar Saifullahi told news agency AFP that the attackers had arrived on about 50 motorcycles, two men apiece. "They looted shops and took cash, foodstuffs and other provisions"

key_facts.fact: 国际特赦组织指控当局未能保护农村社区，并呼吁进行公正调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sanusi called for an impartial investigation into the killings, accusing the authorities of leaving rural communities "at the mercy of gunmen that are repeatedly commit atrocities with impunity".

uncertainties: 实际死亡人数尚未确认，警方称至少10人，目击者称20人，国际特赦组织称可能多达50人
部分人员仍失踪，警方仍在丛林中搜寻其他伤亡人员
目前仅单一来源（BBC News Africa）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
